ERR_maxCurrentBelowMin: Maximum current must be greater than or equal to minimum current
ERR_minCurrentAboveMax: Minimum current must be less than or equal to maximum current
LBL_autoPhaseSwitchHelp: Makes automatic switching between one-phase and three-phase charging available for this wallbox. Settings.PhaseMode then selects fixed one-phase (1), fixed three-phase (3) or automatic (0), which is the default. Only for hardware generation 3 and newer; briefly interrupts charging on each switch.
LBL_stopWhenCarIdle: Withdraw release when the vehicle stops charging
LBL_stopWhenCarIdleHelp: If the vehicle draws no power for 5 minutes although charging is released, the ChargeManager withdraws the release until the vehicle is unplugged or the surplus ends. Helps vehicles such as the Renault Zoe that otherwise stay in charging mode. A running ChargeNOW switches itself off instead.
LBL_batteryModeDisabledDescription: Ignore the home battery; no SOC state is required
LBL_batteryModeMinimumSocDescription: Stop EV charging below the minimum SOC without adding battery power
LBL_batteryModePriorityDescription: Prioritize the battery and gradually release the configured bonus above the minimum SOC
LBL_batterySocHysteresis: Battery SOC hysteresis below the minimum [%]
LBL_batterySocMaxAgeSeconds: Maximum battery SOC age [s] (0 disables the check)
LBL_chargeManagerMaxBatteryBonus: Maximum battery bonus added to the surplus near 100% SoC [W]
LBL_chargeManagerMinCurrent: Minimum ChargeManager current for PV surplus charging [A]
LBL_chargeManagerReservePower: Grid reserve power kept free instead of charging the car [W]
LBL_cycleTime: Time between data polls from the charger [ms]
LBL_gridModeHelp: Where ChargeManager gets the surplus from: separate PV generation and house consumption values, or one signed grid meter value.
LBL_stateGridPower: Object ID of the grid power [W] (import positive, export negative)
LBL_stateGridPowerHelp: Signed power at the grid connection point, e.g. smart meter, Shelly 3EM or inverter P_Grid. It already contains the wallbox power, which ChargeManager adds back automatically.
LBL_gridPowerMaxAgeSeconds: Maximum grid power age [s] (0 disables the check)
LBL_gridPowerMaxAgeSecondsHelp: Surplus charging stops when the grid power has not been updated within this time.
LBL_gridPowerNegateHelp: Inverts the sign, for sources that report export as positive and import as negative.
LBL_gridPowerAckOnlyHelp: Ignores updates with ack=false (e.g. commands written by scripts); the last acknowledged value stays in use.
LBL_maxAmpTotal: Maximum total charging current across all wallboxes [A] (0 = disabled)
LBL_maxAmpTotalHelp: Installation current budget protecting the supply fuse. The summed current of all wallboxes never exceeds it; ChargeNOW is served first, then ChargeManager by priority. 0 disables the limit.
LBL_maxChargeCurrent: Maximum charging current of the power supply for all wallboxes [A]
LBL_maxChargeCurrentHelp: Installation-wide limit (main breaker / supply). Caps ChargeManager (PV surplus) and ChargeNOW for every wallbox.
LBL_readOnlyMode: Read-only mode - charging release is not sent to the charger (for use with RFID tags)
LBL_stateHomeBatSoc: Object ID for the current state of charge of the home battery [%]
LBL_stateHomePowerConsumption: Object ID for the current home power consumption [W]
LBL_homePowerConsumptionNegateHelp: Inverts the sign, for sources that report household consumption as a negative value.
LBL_stateHomeSolarPower: Object ID for the currently available solar power [W]
LBL_solarPowerNegateHelp: Inverts the sign, for sources that report PV generation as a negative value.
LBL_subtractSelfConsumption: Charger consumption is included in the home power consumption value
LBL_wallBoxListHelp: The ChargeManager serves the wallboxes from top to bottom: the first entry receives the PV surplus first, later entries only get what is left over. Use the arrow buttons to change the priority.
LBL_wallboxMaxAmp: Maximum charging current for this wallbox [A] (0 = installation limit)
LBL_wallboxMaxAmpHelp: Highest current for this wallbox, e.g. to throttle it. 0 uses the installation-wide maximum. Never exceeds the installation limit.
LBL_wallboxMinAmp: Minimum charging current for this wallbox [A] (0 = default)
LBL_wallboxMinAmpHelp: Lowest current assigned to this wallbox. 0 uses the technical minimum (6 A).
